concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 3 – Data Ingestion & Cleaning (FR‑010 abort clause)
concerns.text: The plan contains a contradiction: the Specification Amendments (FR‑001, FR‑002, SC‑002) allow raw transcripts to be optional and set lexical/syntactic feature columns to `null` when missing, yet FR‑010 (raw transcript availability check) mandates aborting the pipeline with error 101 if *no* raw transcript is present. This violates internal consistency and the constitution’s reproducibility principle because the pipeline’s behavior is ambiguous.
